Manage root-bound alias commands (no PATH or shell edits)

Usage: larp cc alias [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Install a Larp copy in the data directory's bin folder that launches PROFILE
  list    List aliases
  remove  Remove an alias after verifying its launcher and receipt

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
